description: Create an Airflow DAG for fintech_app that generates the daily settlement file for the payment network. The DAG should: (1) use @task.short_circuit to stop the run when the logical date is a bank holiday according to the ref.bank_holidays table, (2) extract settled transactions, (3) generate the fixed-width settlement file, (4) upload it via SFTP, (5) always run an 'audit_log' task that records whether the run produced a file or was skipped for a holiday. The DAG runs Monday to Friday at 22:00 America/New_York.
edge_cases: ShortCircuit must be configured with ignore_downstream_trigger_rules=False, otherwise the audit task is force-skipped despite trigger_rule='all_done'
Holiday lookup must use the business date in New York time, not the UTC date
Audit record must distinguish 'skipped_holiday' from 'failed' and 'success'
A day with zero settled transactions is not a holiday: an empty file with header and trailer must still be sent
common_failure_modes: FM6: Default ignore_downstream_trigger_rules=True skips the audit task on holidays
FM2: Using the UTC date for a 22:00 New York schedule checks the holiday calendar for the next day
FM7: Empty extract treated as a skip, so the network receives no file on a valid business day
